Weather Kitchen, The.name: The Weather Kitchen
Weather Kitchen, The.summary: The Weather Kitchen is an extremely rare edutainment game for the Philips CD-i, with only two physical copies known to exist. Its aim is to teach children about the science behind weather-related natural disasters through live footage, guessing games, and songs.
